description: Each file here is a copy of a file in bng-metric-harness/example-files/service-template/ (source), built by the harness's corpus recipes or bng-library's generator; its README says how. Refresh them with npm run check:fixtures -- --sync, never by hand.

files.for: A 3-parcel site's baseline-stage file: a baseline upload, and a baseline + post-intervention upload with no post-intervention habitats (POST_INTERVENTION_TABLES_EMPTY)
The same site holding both stages: a baseline + post-intervention upload
The default site's baseline-stage file
The default site holding both stages: vertical area habitats, an Enhanced tree, Retained, Enhanced and Created features linked to their parents, habitats that get worse
A post-intervention feature whose parent's shape has changed: refused, listing the habitats that do not align
A hedgerow that gets worse without 30+ years created in advance: refused (STAGED_HABITAT_DEGRADE_NOT_VALID)
Baseline-stage file for watercourse-degraded.gpkg
A watercourse whose encroachment alone gets worse, 10 years in advance, and one in a lower condition: accepted
Baseline-stage file for watercourse-remeandered.gpkg: R003, a 100 m ditch
R003 re-meandered onto a 130 m route, Enhanced by Realignment: accepted, priced on 130 m with no length lost
Baseline-stage file for every-retention.gpkg: vertical area habitats V001-V004
Vertical area habitats V001 Retained, V002 Enhanced, V003 Created (IGGI), V004 Lost
A vertical area habitat with no Area: refused (VERTICAL_HABITAT_AREA_NOT_POSITIVE)
Created area habitats
H005, Created, with no target condition or timing: accepted, saved Incomplete

H005, Created and linked to its parent, with no habitat type: refused with STAGED_HABITAT_DEGRADE_NOT_VALID, not a missing-type error. The service reads a blank Proposed Habitat Type as the row's Baseline one, so it takes H005 as Created in its parent's own type, a habitat that gets worse (see the harness README)
Baseline-stage file for tree-condition-lowered.gpkg
A tree Created again in a lower condition, 30+ years in advance, and one put back after a delay: accepted
T007 Created again in the same condition: refused (STAGED_TREE_DEGRADE_NOT_VALID)
T007 Created again in a better condition: refused (STAGED_TREE_DEGRADE_NOT_VALID)
T007 Created again in a lower condition only 10 years in advance: refused (STAGED_TREE_DEGRADE_NOT_VALID)
T007 put back after a 5-year delay in its baseline condition: accepted
Baseline-stage file for tree-replanted.gpkg
A tree felled and a new one planted in its place, linked to it: accepted
Every unit type's trading rules met, and the area habitats' net gain above the 10% target: area trading Met, unit deficit 0
Area habitats and trees only Enhanced or Created, none Retained: the area post-intervention page skips its Retained tab
16 trees, Retained, Enhanced and Created, in every size band (T001 Small, T003 Medium, T005 Large, T007 Very large) and both settings
The default site with the Retained H002's Baseline Strategic Significance High in both stages: accepted, priced at Low
A Medium grassland lost (Medium band Not met, -153.69 units) and two Low grasslands enhanced (Low band Met, +166.54); hedgerows, no watercourses. The same figures as the legacy scenario
Baseline-stage file for trading-higher-deficit-not-covered-from-below.gpkg: 3 hedgerows and no watercourses
A Very low hedgerow lost to development: hedgerow Medium and Low Met, Very low Not met (-0.33 units); no watercourses
A Low hedgerow loss (-1.24 units) covered by the Medium surplus (+5.22): hedgerow Medium and Low Met; no watercourses
Every field filled: area habitats +34.9% and trading Met, while hedgerows (-24.1%) and watercourses (-77.9%) are Not met
Every unit type above the 10% target; area habitats +290.4% but their trading rules Not met, hedgerows and watercourses Met
R003 Enhanced on a course 20 m shorter than its parent: watercourses gain 2.7%, above zero and below the 10% target
Baseline area habitats with a padded ref (H034, three spaces each side), a 99-character ref (H050-x…) and two long or non-ASCII ones: accepted, each saved trimmed and whole
HG001, a Native hedgerow enhanced to an Ecologically valuable line of trees, which the Metric gives no time to target: accepted, HG001 saved Incomplete with its enhancement cleared
The default site with the Created HG015 given no Proposed Condition, years created in advance or delay: accepted, HG015 saved Incomplete
The default site with the Enhanced R006's encroachments reduced to Minor and No Encroachment/No Encroachment, against its baseline Major and Moderate/Minor: accepted
R001, a Culvert (Low) enhanced to Ditches Moderate: a Culvert baseline offers Ditches and Canals at every condition, over 10 years (BMD-1047)
The default site with the Enhanced R006's proposed watercourse encroachment blank: saved Incomplete (BMD-1047)
